# Niagize Kariakoo

> Online shop of a single Kariakoo winga (trader) in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. Customers pick products, send the order on WhatsApp, pay by mobile money (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Mixx by Yas, HaloPesa, Selcom) or bank, and get delivery to their door. Prices are in Tanzanian shillings (TSh). Languages: Kiswahili and English.

## How it works
- Browse the shop at https://niagize.tz/ and open any product.
- Tap "Agiza chap" to order. The seller confirms on WhatsApp and sends an invoice with the delivery fee.
- Pay to the number on the invoice, then confirm "Nimepokea" when the goods arrive.

## Facts
- Location: Kariakoo, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.
- Currency: TZS. Delivery: within Dar es Salaam (fee agreed on the invoice).
- Contact: through the WhatsApp button inside the shop.
